jobs.description:
**MBBS Doctor – Skin, Hair \& Aesthetic Field (Full\-Time / Part\-Time / Visiting Consultant)**

**Company:** Lush Aesthetics \& Wellness ( 1st Floor , Chakra Complex Near ICICI Bank, Singa perumal koil)  
**Job Title:** MBBS Doctor  
**Experience:** Freshers \& Experienced Candidates  
**Qualification:** MBBS (Recognised Medical Qualification)  
**Gender:** Male \& Female  
**Age Limit:** No Age Restriction  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time/Part Time / Hourly Basis

Job Description

We are looking for a qualified and dedicated MBBS Doctor to join our Aesthetics \& Wellness team. The candidate should have an interest in aesthetic medicine, dermatology, skin care, hair care and non\-surgical aesthetic procedures.

Freshers and experienced doctors are welcome to apply. Previous experience in aesthetic clinics, skin and hair treatments will be an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct skin and hair consultations for clients.
* Evaluate client concerns and recommend appropriate treatment plans.
* Perform skin and hair assessments.
* Handle PRP and GFC procedures within the doctor's training, competence and applicable clinical protocols.
* Perform injectable procedures where appropriately trained and authorised.
* Explain treatment procedures, benefits, risks and possible side effects to clients.
* Review client medical history and identify contraindications.
* Maintain proper patient records, consent forms and treatment documentation.
* Monitor patient progress and schedule follow\-up consultations.
* Provide pre\-treatment and post\-treatment care instructions.
* Maintain strict hygiene, sterilisation and infection\-control standards.
* Ensure safe handling of medical equipment and consumables.
* Identify cases requiring specialist referral.
* Maintain professional relationships and patient confidentiality.
* Coordinate with therapists and clinic staff for smooth patient care.
* Follow applicable medical ethics, clinical guidelines and regulatory requirements.

Required Skills

* Strong communication and patient\-handling skills.
* Good clinical assessment and consultation skills.
* Interest in aesthetic medicine, skin and hair treatments.
* Knowledge of PRP, GFC and injectable procedures is an advantage.
* Ability to explain treatment options clearly.
* Patient\-friendly attitude and professional behaviour.
* Good documentation and clinical decision\-making skills.
* Willingness to learn new aesthetic procedures and technologies.

Eligibility Criteria

* MBBS degree from a recognised medical institution.
* Valid registration with the appropriate State Medical Council/National Medical Register, as applicable.
* Freshers are welcome.
* Experienced doctors are preferred but not mandatory.
* Aesthetic, dermatology, cosmetology, skin or hair clinic experience will be an added advantage.
* Training in PRP, GFC and aesthetic procedures is desirable.

Job Type

Full\-Time /Part Time / Hourly Basis

Contact Number \- 98401 53035 , 77080 74087

**Interested candidates can apply with their updated CV and medical registration details.**

**Build your career in Aesthetic Medicine with Lush Aesthetics \& Wellness!**

Pay: ₹45,000\.00 \- ₹75,000\.00 per month

jobs.description:
Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) – All Subjects Required

**Job Title:** Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) – All Subjects  
**Department:** Middle / Secondary School  
**Reports To:** Principal / Academic Coordinator / Head of Department

Job Summary

We are seeking qualified, dedicated, and enthusiastic **Trained Graduate Teachers (TGT)** to teach students at the middle and secondary levels. The teacher will be responsible for delivering high\-quality, curriculum\-based instruction, assessing student performance, maintaining classroom discipline, and supporting students’ overall academic and personal development.

Key Responsibilities

* Plan and deliver engaging, curriculum\-based lessons for assigned subjects.
* Teach **English, Hindi, Mathematics, Science, Social Science, Computer Science, and other subjects** according to qualification and school requirements.
* Prepare lesson plans, worksheets, assignments, projects, question papers, and teaching resources.
* Use interactive, activity\-based, and technology\-enabled teaching methods.
* Conduct regular tests, assessments, examinations, and revision sessions.
* Monitor student performance and provide additional academic support where required.
* Identify individual learning needs and implement appropriate teaching strategies.
* Maintain classroom discipline and create a safe, respectful, and inclusive learning environment.
* Develop students’ critical thinking, creativity, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Maintain accurate attendance, academic, and assessment records.
* Communicate with parents/guardians regarding students’ academic progress when required.
* Participate in school functions, examinations, staff meetings, workshops, training programs, and co\-curricular activities.
* Collaborate with other teachers and school management to improve academic outcomes.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s Degree in the **relevant subject** from a recognized university.
* **B.Ed. / equivalent recognized teacher\-training qualification.**
* CTET/TET qualification will be an advantage.
* Strong subject knowledge and understanding of relevant teaching methodologies.
* Previous teaching experience in a recognized school is preferred.

Key Skills

* Excellent subject knowledge
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Effective classroom management
* Lesson planning and assessment
* Technology\-enabled teaching
* Student mentoring and motivation
* Critical thinking and problem\-solving
* Teamwork and collaboration
* Good organizational and time\-management skills

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 1–5 years preferred  
**Subjects:** All TGT Subjects / Subject as per Qualification  
**Classes:** Middle \& Secondary School  
**Location:** \[School/Institution Location]

Work Location: In person
